name: io.github.francodesystems/odoo-verifactu-mcp
title: Odoo Veri*Factu & SII (Spain)
description: Veri*Factu and SII in Odoo: AEAT status and errors per invoice, QR, CSV and VAT by tax. Read-only.

environmentVariables.name: ODOO_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your Odoo, e.g. https://mycompany.odoo.com

environmentVariables.name: ODOO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Odoo API key (Preferences > Account Security > New API Key)

environmentVariables.name: ODOO_DB
environmentVariables.description: Database name. Needed with several databases and on Odoo 16-18.

environmentVariables.name: ODOO_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: User login. Only on Odoo 16-18 (JSON-RPC); leave unset on Odoo 19+.
